description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape patient care standards, foster a supportive environment for nursing staff, and ensure the highest quality of service delivery.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, including staff management, regulatory compliance, and the implementation of best practices in patient care. We are looking for a visionary leader who can inspire excellence and drive positive outcomes for our residents. This is an urgent opening for a highly qualified candidate.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Proven ability to manage, mentor, and develop nursing staff
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $105,000, based on experience.
